ns2:course.label: Machine Learning for Accounting
ns2:course.description: This course introduces machine learning algorithms and their applications in accounting problems. It covers classification, regression, clustering, text analysis, time series analysis. It also discusses feature importance and model optimization. 2 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: ACCY 576.
